messages:
Maya (AE): Heads up — MedTech Systems asked for a bespoke rate on a dedicated POC. They're requesting 35% off for a 12mo commit citing extra security and onboarding work. Can we fast-track a deal-desk review? Details below.

Juan (Sales Eng): Quick tech summary: they need VPC/private deploy + KMS/HSM integrations, SOC2 evidence, and a pen test report. POC will require two reserved nodes during the trial window. That adds ~ $12k/mo in infra/run costs. ping @Raman for deal desk.

Priya (Procurement - MedTech): Procurement here. We're OK with a 12mo commitment but need monthly SLAs and strict key custody. 35% is the budget target to get this over our procurement threshold. Can you break down the price drivers?

Raman (Deal Desk): Need numbers to evaluate: ACV, list price, expected margin after the discount, and any one-time onboarding costs. Anything >25% discount will need VP signoff.

Maya (AE): ACV if they convert: $420k (first 12mo at list). List monthly run-rate: ~$35k/mo. POC-phase run cost estimated at $18k/mo (reserved infra + SRE support). They're explicitly asking 35% off list for the first 12 months.

Elsa (Security): We can support VPC + KMS, but we need proof-of-controls: latest SOC2 Type II + pen-test summary. Private deploy onboarding timeline is ~4–6 weeks and will require ~80hrs of security/SRE time for hardening. That increases onboarding effort/cost.

Raman (Deal Desk): 35% + the extra onboarding spend pushes gross margin too low (approx ~12%). Proposal: offer 20% off list AND a one-time onboarding credit to cover the SRE/security hours (~$18k). Also include a DPA addendum and documented key custody options. That keeps economics sane and addresses their concerns.

Juan (Sales Eng): 20% + $18k credit seems reasonable from an infra perspective. Also recommend a short performance addendum for the POC (pre-commit to monitoring + named engineer) so they feel supported.

Priya (Procurement - MedTech): Please put that in writing. If you can add a clause: "onboarding credit applied against the first invoice" and a clear description of key custody options, we can take this to legal immediately.

Raman (Deal Desk): I'll draft a short term sheet. Note: Tyler (VP Sales) needs to sign off on anything above 25% or non-standard T&Cs.

Tyler (VP Sales): Looping in. Quick read: 20% + $18k onboarding credit + standard DPA + 12mo commit — approved from me. Anything that creates long-term margin leakage or custom SLA language needs to be routed through legal.

Maya (AE): Customer also wants a monthly SLA during POC (they requested 99.9% uptime for trial). Is that something we can promise?

Elsa (Security): We can’t commit to a formal 99.9% SLA during a POC. Offer: named SRE during onboarding and "best-effort" availability for the trial. For production/dedicated we can spin up SLA language once infra is hardened.

Priya (Procurement - MedTech): Best-effort support during trial is acceptable if it's documented in the term sheet.

Raman (Deal Desk): Drafted term sheet snippet below for internal review:
```
List price (monthly): $35,000
Discount: 20% -> $28,000/month
Onboarding credit: $18,000 applied to first invoice
Commit term: 12 months
POC infra support: named engineer + best-effort availability (documented)
Security deliverables: SOC2 Type II report + pen-test summary required prior to prod cutover
```

Raman (Deal Desk): Routing to @Tyler for final sign-off and to @Priya for legal review. I'll create the Deal Desk ticket and attach the draft term sheet.

Priya (Procurement - MedTech): :thumbsup: Please also put key-custody options in the term sheet (customer-managed KMS vs Redwood-managed with BYOK).

Dealbot (system): Deal Desk ticket created: #DD-4721 — assigned to Raman. https://redwood.internal/dd/4721

Maya (AE): Thanks all — I'll circulate the term sheet to the customer and lock POC dates once we have legal ok. cc @Alyssa (CSM) to prep onboarding.

Alyssa (CSM): I'll prepare the onboarding runbook and schedule the named engineer for the trial window. Available dates: Mar 8–22.

Maya (AE): Great — moving to customer review. Will update thread with their feedback.
